title: Verify Word Pronunciation Feature
description: End-to-end verification that word pronunciation audio works correctly.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Start dev server if not running: bun run dev
Verify audio files exist in public/audio/words/ directory
Take screenshot showing lyrics with word tokens visible
Click on a Persian word (e.g., 'برای' - baraye)
Verify audio plays (check for no console errors, visual feedback shown)
Take screenshot showing word highlight/feedback during playback
Click another word quickly - verify previous audio stops, new plays
Click same word multiple times rapidly - no audio overlap or errors
Test word from different line to ensure all words work
Use mcp__browser-tools__getConsoleErrors - verify no JavaScript errors
Use mcp__browser-tools__getNetworkErrors - verify no failed audio requests
Verify clicking word does NOT interfere with line playback modes
Test in Loop mode - clicking word plays pronunciation, loop continues after
Final screenshot showing successful word audio feature
